narrative.northStar: Calm clarity for everyday household spending.
narrative.overview: Kesefly uses blue accents, cool neutral surfaces, dark ink text, and restrained rounded controls for everyday household expense management. The approved direction is calm, trustworthy, modern, and Android-first, using Vietnamese copy and VND amounts.
keyCharacteristics: Blue identity and the existing lowercase kesefly / k. mark.
Readable financial information and explicit transaction states.
Approved destination: Material Design 3 through React Native Paper.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Labels and amounts must communicate state without relying on color. Spending is not an error.

dos: Use the approved brief for future UX decisions and this baseline to understand existing code.
Keep Vietnamese labels, full VND amounts, and explicit financial states.
Preserve role ownership and existing route/data contracts.
Verify contrast, large text, TalkBack, keyboard insets, and Android Back on rendered native screens.
donts: Do not treat this baseline as a seed or as proof of a completed Paper migration.
Do not copy existing small labels or undersized controls into new screens when they conflict with the approved brief.
Do not invent financial records, savings claims, or backend capabilities.
Do not use decoration, gradients, or AI-dashboard motifs to replace useful financial hierarchy.
